name: <Ghost> Town
source:
This is a story set in the ghost town outside the city, about a guy who hates people and a girl who helps ghosts called "Phantoms" who are unable to move on due to their attachment to this world.
But there's a connection between the "phantoms" and the girl, which later leads to sudden twists.
What is their secret?

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ01117599.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
故事发生在城外的一座鬼城之中，围绕一名厌恶世人的青年，以及一位专门帮助因留恋现世而无法成佛的幽灵——“幻灵”的少女展开。
然而，“幻灵”与少女之间实则暗藏着某种渊源，并将在日后引出一连串突如其来的惊人反转。
他们背后究竟隐藏着怎样的秘密？

[摘自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ01117599.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
